description.en: Applies a lighting setup as the active scene lighting.
Handle of the light setup to apply, or a constant like DEFAULT_LIGHT to restore the default lighting.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Restore the default scene lighting
CMND_SET_LIGHT(DEFAULT_LIGHT);
